lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
tables-main: 15,640 B beyond the first copy, focus-trap 13,767 B, debounce 949 B, @nextcloud/vue 444 B.
css holds 4 stylesheets, 7,227 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.

Loaded from PHP: error.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), grid.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), modal.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), tiptap.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php).
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
moment, 292,726 B on the tables-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,353 B on the tables-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
All 3 pages load the same 1 file: 17,684 B raw, 6,199 B gzip, 12.8 % of the smallest page (tables-files, 137,643 B).
Inside: semver 8,988 B, @nextcloud/logger 2,056 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 1,874 B, @nextcloud/event-bus 1,330 B, @nextcloud/auth 1,025 B.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (176 packages, 1,203 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
